meta.description: Prachyaporn Saensla, early childhood teacher in Chiang Rai — child development, hands-on Active Learning and mental arithmetic.

profile.name: Prachyaporn Saensla
profile.summary: An early childhood teacher with a degree in the field, specialising in child developmental psychology and hands-on Active Learning. Skilled at classroom management and at communicating with young children warmly and patiently while holding their attention. Grounded in mental-arithmetic and finger-counting methods, and eager to train in an institute's abacus programme. Also tutors mathematics, Thai and English at preschool and primary level.

hero.tagline: A teacher who believes every child learns best by <drawn>doing</drawn>.

points.p1: Care closely for kindergarten pupils — daily routines, hygiene and safety.
points.p2: Design lesson plans, run learning activities and make my own teaching materials.
points.p3: Build behaviour assessment plans and observe each child's development, grounded in developmental psychology.
points.p4: Co-organise enrichment projects such as the STEM project "Fun with Natural Colours".

earlyYears.title: Early Years & Child Psychology
earlyYears.body: Whole-child development, communication that fits how young children think, and a classroom where focus feels like fun.

mentalMath.title: Mental Arithmetic
mentalMath.body: Mental-arithmetic and finger-counting methods that train focus, memory and systematic thinking.

tutoring.title: Academic Tutoring
tutoring.body: Primary tutoring (grades 1–6) in mathematics and Thai, with conversational English.

parents.title: Parent Communication
parents.body: Warm, regular updates on each child's progress for parents, and teaching materials made by hand.
